about: READ-ONLY — verify one exact source generation of the native-agent image publisher. Reads the root-owned immutable image witness and complete retained originals, checks every blob and native executable witness, and prints the image-only record. Refuses missing, changed, linked or replaceable records; never emits a ready login/controller binding. The cluster converge publishes this separate image after core convergence and records agent_image_publication on its maintenance packet even on failure. No image build, push, login, launch or credential read occurs in this verb. Partial3869107c.
